rationale: C25 plausibly supplied a concrete template: it concerns Northwest Airlines employees represented by the International Association of Machinists—one of the same carrier-union pairings incorporated into the child—and uses essentially the same recital sequence, thirty-day reporting requirement, and section 10 status-quo provision. The child adapts that machinery from a single airline to several airlines. C07 shares the same carrier and union but differs in the transportation-impact formulation, while C19 is a very recent, nearly verbatim structural precedent without the distinctive party overlap.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a dispute exists between the Capital Airlines, Inc., National Airlines, Inc., Northwest Airlines, Inc., Trans World Airlines, Inc., United Airlines, Inc., Eastern Airlines, Inc., carriers, and certain of their employees represented by the International Association of Machinists
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a dispute exists between the Northwest Airlines, Inc., a carrier and certain of its employees represented by the International Association of Machinists
shared_material.explanation: The child expands the parent’s specific Northwest Airlines–Machinists dispute formulation to a multi-carrier dispute involving the same union.

shared_material.child_excerpt: this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.explanation: The statutory recital is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The principal reporting command is verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by any of the said carriers or their employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided in section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Northwest Airlines, Inc., or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The child retains the same section 10 status-quo machinery while substituting the aggregated carriers for Northwest Airlines.
